narrative.title: Glitch Pigeon format
narrative.summary: A new joke format where ordinary street pigeons are captioned as corrupted NPCs dropping side-quest dialogue. Multiple unrelated accounts posted original variants within three hours.

score_explanations.freshness: First variants appeared within the last three hours; still forming.
score_explanations.organic_engagement: Replies add new dialogue lines rather than single-emoji spam; exact metrics partially unavailable.
score_explanations.meme_potential: Easy to remix: pigeon + glitch caption template.
score_explanations.originality: Not a celebrity-name or standard animal-coin clone.
score_explanations.cultural_relevance: Riffs on NPC/side-quest internet slang already broadly understood.

narrative.why_interesting: The format is compressible into a character + catchphrase without needing a real-world celebrity.
